name: Uptime Kotlin
description: Uptime Kotlin is an open-source monitoring tool that tracks the uptime of your websites and services. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Uptime Kotlin as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Uptime and website monitoring tool. Deploy Uptime Kotlin with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
